boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain SUNY College at Geneseo
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and convenience destinations with directly verified late availability in Geneseo or on campus.

cards.title: Wendy’s
cards.subtitle: 4158 Lakeville Road, Geneseo
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-thru when you need a food option later in the evening; confirm the posted hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Geneseo fast-food stop with midnight restaurant and drive-thru hours listed daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Geneseo location page lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours as 10:00 AM–12:00 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 12:00 AM daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell / KFC
cards.subtitle: 4200 Lakeville Road, Geneseo
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru or dine-in before the listed closing time, and recheck the location page if you are traveling during breaks.
cards.short_summary: A Lakeville Road food stop whose official listing marks it open late.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Taco Bell page for 4200 Lakeville Road lists drive-thru hours through 11:00 PM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru hours of 6:00 AM–11:00 PM daily.

cards.title: McDonald’s
cards.subtitle: 4162 Lakeville Road, Geneseo
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check the day’s service before leaving; both lobby and drive-thru are listed through late evening.
cards.short_summary: A Geneseo McDonald’s with 11 PM closing listed for its restaurant and drive-thru.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page for 4162 Lakeville Road lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows 11:00 PM closing for the lobby and drive-thru every day.

cards.title: Wegmans Geneseo
cards.subtitle: 4287 Genesee Valley Plaza, Geneseo
cards.notes: For groceries or prepared food, check the store page before a late errand and allow time to finish shopping before midnight.
cards.short_summary: A full grocery-store option open until midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wegmans’ official Geneseo store page says the store is open 6 AM to midnight, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists hours of 6:00 AM–12:00 AM, seven days a week.

cards.title: 7-Eleven
cards.subtitle: 137 Main Street, Geneseo
cards.notes: Keep this Main Street convenience stop in mind for a late snack or basic essentials; the official listing identifies it as open around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 convenience-store option on Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven’s official page for 137 Main Street in Geneseo states that the store is open 24/7 and offers hot foods.
cards.access_notes: Official location page states “Open 24/7.”

cards.title: Pizza Paul’s
cards.subtitle: 110 Main Street, Geneseo
cards.notes: For a Friday or Saturday evening food run, check the Geneseo location’s ordering options and arrive before the posted 10 PM close.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizzeria with later Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Paul’s official site lists its Geneseo location at 110 Main Street and hours until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Geneseo hours until 10:00 PM Friday–Saturday; Sunday–Thursday close at 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Mama Mia’s
cards.subtitle: 87 Main Street, Geneseo
cards.notes: During a semester, use the restaurant’s contact page to confirm the current schedule before going; the listed semester hours extend to 10 PM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizza destination with semester hours posted through 10 PM Friday–Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Mama Mia’s official contact page lists semester hours of 11 AM–10 PM Friday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists semester hours until 10:00 PM Friday–Sunday and notes that hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Market North
cards.subtitle: Letchworth Dining Complex, SUNY Geneseo campus
cards.notes: Check the campus dining schedule before stopping by, then use this Letchworth convenience store for packaged food, snacks, and beverages.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store with a listed 10 PM weekday service window.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s dining menu identifies Market North in Letchworth and lists it from 4:00 PM to 10:00 PM on weekdays.
cards.access_notes: Campus menu page lists Market North from 4:00 PM–10:00 PM on weekdays; check break-period changes first.

cards.title: Books & Bites
cards.subtitle: Milne Library, SUNY Geneseo campus
cards.notes: Check the dining schedule and library access before you go; this campus café lists snacks and drinks through a late weekday closing time.
cards.short_summary: A campus café in Milne Library listed through 10 PM on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s dining menu lists Books & Bites in Milne Library with retail coffee, drinks, and snacks from 7:30 AM to 10:00 PM on weekdays.
cards.access_notes: Campus menu page lists Books & Bites 7:30 AM–10:00 PM on weekdays; availability can change during breaks.

cards.title: Starbucks at MacVittie College Union
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, SUNY Geneseo campus
cards.notes: Check campus dining and building hours before a late weekday stop; the menu page lists drinks, snacks, and hot sandwiches through 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: A campus Union café with a listed 10 PM weekday closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s dining menu lists Starbucks in MacVittie College Union from 7:30 AM to 10:00 PM on weekdays.
cards.access_notes: Campus menu page lists Starbucks 7:30 AM–10:00 PM on weekdays; confirm break-period operations first.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus places with documented spaces for studying, gathering, recreation, or community connection.

cards.title: Milne Library
cards.subtitle: 37 University Dr.
cards.notes: Use the collaboration and innovation areas for a study session, then choose a naturally lit spot to regroup between classes.
cards.short_summary: A renovated library with study, collaboration, and gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes Milne Library as having collaboration and innovation spaces, natural light, and places to study, play pool, and meet friends.
cards.access_notes: Enter only while the building is open; consult current campus building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Fireside Lounge
cards.subtitle: Inside Milne Library
cards.notes: Bring your reading or laptop and use the lounge as a shared meeting point before settling into the library’s other work areas.
cards.short_summary: A named lounge for studying within Milne Library.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo identifies the Fireside Lounge in Milne Library as a place where students can study.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Milne Library; building access depends on current library hours.

cards.title: Corner Pocket
cards.subtitle: Inside Milne Library
cards.notes: Meet classmates for a break from coursework, then return to the library’s study spaces when you are ready to continue.
cards.short_summary: A named pool-playing spot inside the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says students can play a game of pool in the Corner Pocket at Milne Library.
cards.access_notes: Inside Milne Library; verify building access and any equipment procedures on arrival.

cards.title: MacVittie College Union
cards.subtitle: 10 MacVittie Cir.
cards.notes: Use the Union as a practical stop to meet up, find study areas, or connect with student and residential-life offices.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub with study areas and student-facing offices.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo identifies the Union as the heart of campus life and lists study areas, Student Engagement, Residential Life, and the Student Association there.
cards.access_notes: Check current College Union building hours before going.

cards.title: The Union’s Outdoor Plaza
cards.subtitle: Second-floor lobby, MacVittie College Union
cards.notes: Take a meal or reading outside and use the second-floor plaza as a daytime place to study or meet friends.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor Union space intended for eating, studying, and meeting.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes the large outdoor plaza off the College Union’s second-floor lobby as a place to eat, study, and meet friends.
cards.access_notes: Access is tied to College Union availability and weather conditions.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: First floor, MacVittie College Union
cards.notes: If you commute, use this first-floor lounge near the mailroom as a defined place to pause, work, or organize your day.
cards.short_summary: A designated first-floor lounge for commuting students.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists a commuter lounge on the first floor of the MacVittie College Union next to the mailroom.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Union; consult current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Multicultural Center
cards.subtitle: Blake Hall
cards.notes: Drop in for relaxation, creative expression, or community connection; contact Scheduling and Events if you want to reserve it for an event.
cards.short_summary: A Blake Hall space for community, cultural development, and creative expression.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says the Multicultural Center in Blake Hall supports community and cultural development, relaxation, and creative expression.
cards.access_notes: The official center page lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m.; contact Scheduling and Events for reservations.

cards.title: Geneseo Arboretum
cards.subtitle: South Side, near the Onondaga main parking lot
cards.notes: Follow the nature trail at your own pace, or join the listed Wednesday guided walk when it fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus arboretum and nature-trail destination.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists the Arboretum Nature Trail on campus near the Onondaga main parking lot and says guided walks meet Wednesdays at noon.
cards.access_notes: The university says visitors may explore independently; use marked paths and check conditions before heading out.

cards.title: Greenhouse in Newton
cards.subtitle: Newton Hall
cards.notes: Add the greenhouse to a science-side walk and confirm building access before planning an indoor visit.
cards.short_summary: A named on-campus greenhouse located in Newton.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists the Greenhouse in Newton among its on-campus places to visit.
cards.source_title: Things to Do in Western New York
cards.access_notes: Inside Newton; confirm current building access and any greenhouse-specific rules before visiting.

cards.title: Ira S. Wilson Ice Arena
cards.subtitle: Myrtle A. Merritt Athletic Center
cards.notes: Check the open-recreation schedule, bring your own skates, and sign in at the arena entrance before recreational skating.
cards.short_summary: The campus ice arena offers scheduled recreational skating.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo identifies the Ira S. Wilson Ice Arena in Merritt Athletic Center and provides recreational-skating instructions for its open recreation.
cards.access_notes: Open-skate schedules may change; users must sign in at the arena entrance and bring their own skates.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission outdoor activities at SUNY Geneseo’s Spencer J. Roemer Arboretum.

cards.title: Walk the Outer Loop
cards.subtitle: Spencer J. Roemer Arboretum
cards.notes: Start at the arboretum entrance and take the outer loop at an easy pace; pause to look for the marked oak and walnut trees.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided loop through the campus woods.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo identifies the outer loop as just over one-half mile; the arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: The arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

cards.title: Take the Inner Loop
cards.subtitle: Spencer J. Roemer Arboretum
cards.notes: Use the inner route for a shorter woodland walk, then compare its course with the outer loop on the posted trail map.
cards.short_summary: A nearly half-mile alternative through the arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes the inner loop as nearly one-half mile and states the arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: The arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

cards.title: Browse the Native Plant Gardens
cards.subtitle: Near the Roemer Arboretum entrance
cards.notes: Meet near the entrance and slowly scan the native gardens together; use the visit as a low-key break before heading back across campus.
cards.short_summary: A garden-side pause at the arboretum entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says native plant gardens are near the arboretum entrance and that the arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: The arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

cards.title: Pause at the 9/11 Memorial
cards.subtitle: Near the Roemer Arboretum entrance
cards.notes: Include the memorial on a reflective walk through the arboretum; keep the visit quiet and leave the site exactly as you found it.
cards.short_summary: A reflective stop in the campus arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists a 9/11 memorial near the arboretum entrance and states the arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: The arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

cards.title: Meet at the Gazebo
cards.subtitle: Spencer J. Roemer Arboretum
cards.notes: Use the gazebo as a simple meetup point, then take a few minutes to look out over the grounds before continuing along the paths.
cards.short_summary: A covered landmark for a calm outdoor meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo identifies a gazebo in the arboretum and says visitors may enjoy the view from it; the arboretum is free of charge.
cards.access_notes: The arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

cards.title: Bring a Conversation to the Picnic Tables
cards.subtitle: Spencer J. Roemer Arboretum
cards.notes: Gather at the picnic tables with no purchase required; bring only what you already have and carry all belongings back out with you.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor table stop inside the arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists picnic tables in the arboretum and states that the arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: The arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

cards.title: Find the Arboretum Oaks
cards.subtitle: Spencer J. Roemer Arboretum trail network
cards.notes: Follow the trail map to the indicated oaks and take time to compare their size and form from the path without leaving the trail.
cards.short_summary: A tree-spotting walk around the arboretum’s mature oaks.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s trail map identifies majestic oak trees, many over 200 years old; the arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: The arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

cards.title: Look for the Black Walnuts
cards.subtitle: Spencer J. Roemer Arboretum trail network
cards.notes: Use the map’s marked black walnut trees as a destination for a short walk; stay on the path and leave plants and nuts in place.
cards.short_summary: A map-guided search for a named arboretum tree group.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s trail map identifies black walnut trees, and the arboretum history describes several black walnuts estimated to be over 100 years old; entry is free.
cards.access_notes: The arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

cards.title: Plan a Walk at the Entrance Kiosk
cards.subtitle: Spencer J. Roemer Arboretum entrance
cards.notes: Meet at the entrance kiosk, choose either loop together, and check the posted trail information before setting out through the woods.
cards.short_summary: A practical starting point for a self-guided arboretum hang.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo documents an entrance kiosk with trail-map and trail-condition information for arboretum visitors; the arboretum is open free of charge.
cards.access_notes: The arboretum is open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

cards.title: Take a Dawn-to-Dusk Arboretum Walk
cards.subtitle: Spencer J. Roemer Arboretum
cards.notes: Choose any established path for an unhurried walk with friends, then finish at the gazebo or entrance gardens before dusk.
cards.short_summary: A flexible, no-cost walk on the arboretum’s established paths.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo states that the Roemer Arboretum is open, free of charge, from dawn to dusk and encourages visitors to walk its paths.
cards.access_notes: Open free of charge from dawn to dusk. During academic-year weekdays, visitors need a parking permit for Lot J before 4 p.m.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus study environments, spanning quiet, group, computer, sensory-friendly, indoor, and outdoor options.

cards.title: Milne Library
cards.subtitle: 37 University Dr.
cards.notes: Use the library for a study session with natural light, collaboration areas, and innovation spaces; check library access information before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A renovated academic hub with varied study settings.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes the renovated Milne Library as having collaboration and innovation spaces and lots of natural light.
cards.access_notes: Building access depends on current library hours and campus access policies.

cards.title: Milne Library Quiet Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Milne Library, first and third floors
cards.notes: Choose a designated quiet-study area when you need fewer interruptions; keep your materials contained and follow posted library expectations.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated quiet areas within the renovated library.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo's Milne Library project information lists two quiet study spaces on the first floor and two on the third floor.
cards.source_title: Naming Opportunities: Milne Library - SUNY Geneseo
cards.access_notes: Located in Milne Library; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Milne Library Group Study Rooms

cards.notes: Reserve a library study room for a focused group session; informational QR codes outside rooms provide the reservation route.

cards.source_title: How to Book a Room - SUNY Geneseo
cards.access_notes: Student reservation is required; use the QR code posted outside the desired room.

cards.title: College Union Study Room 134
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, first floor
cards.notes: Set up in Room 134 for a straightforward indoor work block; plan around the College Union's regular building hours.
cards.short_summary: A designated first-floor study room in the College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo identifies Room 134 on the first floor of the College Union as a study room open during regular building hours.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular College Union building hours.

cards.title: Computer Project Area (CoPA)
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, Room 112
cards.notes: Use CoPA when your work needs a campus computer or printing; bring files in a format you can access on Mac or PC.
cards.short_summary: A computer lab with printing in the College Union.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says the Computer Project Area in Room 112 has Mac and PC computers plus color and black-and-white network printers.
cards.access_notes: Located in the College Union; access is subject to building hours and available equipment.

cards.title: College Union Conference Room 324
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, third floor
cards.notes: Check the room card outside Room 324; when it is not reserved, use it for a small study session and leave it as found.
cards.short_summary: A conference room available for study when unreserved.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists Conference Room 324 among College Union rooms that may be used for studying when not reserved.
cards.access_notes: Available only when not reserved; verify the room card outside the door.

cards.title: College Union Conference Room 325
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, third floor
cards.notes: Check Room 325's posted reservation status before settling in; keep the conference setup intact for the next scheduled users.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor conference room usable between reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists Conference Room 325 among College Union rooms that may be used for studying when not reserved.
cards.access_notes: Available only when not reserved; verify the room card outside the door.

cards.title: Bailey Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Bailey Hall, 25 Brodie Dr.
cards.notes: Bring a charged device and work from the atrium seating; the college notes that this building also has research labs downstairs.
cards.short_summary: An atrium study setting in the social-sciences building.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says Bailey Hall's atrium has many study spaces and that research labs are downstairs.
cards.access_notes: Access is subject to Bailey Hall's current building hours.

cards.title: Erwin 14 Sensory/Study Room
cards.subtitle: Erwin Hall, Room 14
cards.notes: Use the low-lit, sensory-friendly room for quiet focus or a reset; schedule your visit during the stated weekday opening window.
cards.short_summary: A low-lit sensory-friendly room for study or decompression.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes Erwin 14 as a quiet, comfy, low-lit sensory-friendly study and wellness space open to all.
cards.source_title: Office of Accessibility Services - SUNY Geneseo
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:15 p.m., according to the Office of Accessibility Services.

cards.title: College Green
cards.subtitle: 37 Sturges Path
cards.notes: For an outdoor change of scene, work on the Green with a weather-ready setup; SUNY Geneseo notes campus-wide Wi-Fi there.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus space with campus-wide Wi-Fi.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes College Green as an outdoor hub for getting work done and states that campus-wide Wi-Fi is available.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; use is weather-dependent.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, campus-adjacent Geneseo destinations on Main Street and nearby downtown corridors, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Village Park: use the public green
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Route 20A corridor
cards.notes: Start at the Main Street edge of campus, then use the benches, gardens, picnic tables, lawn, or Veterans’ Memorial for a daylight pause.
cards.short_summary: A civic park with outdoor amenities at Main Street and Route 20A.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Park is at Main Street and Route 20A and has picnic tables, benches, gardens, lawn, a Veterans’ Memorial, and a historic log cabin.
cards.access_notes: Public park; check the Village for any event-specific reservation or access details.

cards.title: Bear Fountain: find the Main Street landmark
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk to the Center Street intersection and photograph the fountain from the sidewalk while taking in this documented civic landmark.
cards.short_summary: A historic, aesthetic, and cultural landmark at Main and Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village’s plan identifies the Bear Fountain at Main and Center streets as a historic, aesthetic, and cultural landmark.
cards.access_notes: View from public sidewalks at the intersection.

cards.title: Wadsworth Homestead: spot a local historic site
cards.subtitle: South Street / Route 20A corridor
cards.notes: Continue just south of Village Park to see the documented Wadsworth Homestead address and check its own calendar before attending an event.
cards.short_summary: A named historical-site destination on South Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Geneseo lists Wadsworth Homestead as a historical site at 4 South Street in Geneseo.
cards.access_notes: Event access and any fees depend on the specific program.

cards.title: The Geneseo Riviera: check the program
cards.subtitle: Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the venue’s current listings before you go; its rental information documents screenings, concerts, presentations, and other special events.
cards.short_summary: A local venue for screenings, concerts, and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Geneseo Riviera states that its venue is used for concerts, screenings, meetings, presentations, and special events.
cards.access_notes: Admission, schedule, and access vary by event; consult the venue before visiting.

cards.title: County Historical Museum: follow Center Street
cards.subtitle: Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Turn east from Main Street at the Bear Fountain and look for the museum just beyond the first stop sign on the right.
cards.short_summary: A Center Street museum reached from the Bear Fountain.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s directions say to turn east from Main Street at the Bear Fountain onto Center Street; it is at 30 Center Street.
cards.source_title: Location — Livingston County Historical Society Museum
cards.access_notes: The museum reports free parking and partial accessibility; confirm visiting hours directly.

cards.title: Wadsworth Library: use the downtown library
cards.subtitle: Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Head to 24 Center Street for a library stop; consult the library directly for current hours, programs, borrowing, and room-use details.
cards.short_summary: The public library is a named Center Street destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Geneseo lists Wadsworth Library at 24 Center Street, Geneseo.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current website or contact it for hours and service availability.

cards.title: Highland Park: use the recreation facilities
cards.subtitle: Highland Road corridor
cards.notes: Take the off-campus loop toward Highland Road and use the park’s documented courts, fields, pavilion, playground, or seasonal ice rink as available.
cards.short_summary: A Highland Road park with several recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village plan identifies Highland Park on Highland Road and lists tennis and basketball courts, fields, a pavilion, playground, and winter ice rink.
cards.access_notes: Facilities and seasonal availability may change; confirm conditions with the Village.

cards.title: Temple Hill Cemetery: take a self-guided history walk
cards.subtitle: Temple Hill Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit during daylight, follow the paths, and use the cemetery’s self-guided tour material to explore documented local and Normal School history.
cards.short_summary: A daylight-accessible cemetery with self-guided historic tours.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Hill Cemetery offers self-guided tours including Geneseo history and SUNY Geneseo’s early Normal School years.
cards.access_notes: The cemetery says it is open daily from dawn until dusk; remain on paths when possible.

cards.title: Geneseo Methodist Church: orient on the loop

cards.notes: Use this named nearby establishment as an orientation point while following the university’s listed off-campus bus-stop sequence through downtown.
cards.short_summary: A named establishment on the university’s off-campus bus-stop list.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s bus-stop page lists Geneseo Methodist Church among establishments near its off-campus route stops.
cards.source_title: Bus Stops with Nearby Businesses and Services
cards.access_notes: This card is for route orientation; respect private worship and event access rules.

cards.title: Geneseo Square Plaza: use a named route stop
cards.subtitle: South Street / Route 20A corridor
cards.notes: Use the university’s off-campus route information to locate this named plaza stop, then verify individual businesses and services before making a trip.
cards.short_summary: A named plaza on SUNY Geneseo’s off-campus route.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s bus-stop page identifies Geneseo Square Plaza as a stop on its listed route.
cards.source_title: Bus Stops with Nearby Businesses and Services
cards.access_notes: Check the university’s current transportation information and individual destinations before travel.

cards.title: Show Your Class Pride
cards.subtitle: Class pride pin tradition
cards.notes: Pick up your class pride pin at First Knight or the Student Org Expo, then display it somewhere you will see it during the year.
cards.short_summary: A visible class-year marker tied to Geneseo’s UAA traditions program.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists showing class pride as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA lists this as a current Annual Traditions Challenge activity; no cost to participate is stated on the page.

cards.title: Paint the Tree
cards.subtitle: UAA Annual Traditions Challenge
cards.notes: Document the painted tree when your organization or cause is represented, and follow campus and organization guidance before taking part.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus-tree tradition included in Geneseo’s current challenge.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists “Paint the Tree” among its current Annual Traditions Challenge activities.
cards.access_notes: The UAA identifies this as a current tradition and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Capture a Sunset at the Gazebo
cards.subtitle: Campus gazebo tradition
cards.notes: Visit the gazebo near sunset and take a photo from a public, open area; check weather and daylight conditions before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A photo-based sunset tradition centered on Geneseo’s gazebo.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists capturing a sunset at the Gazebo as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA marks this tradition as photo-required and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Lounge on the College Green
cards.subtitle: College Green or Sturges Quad tradition

boards.title: Your First Weekend at SUNY College at Geneseo, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence using campus resources, orientation programming, recreation, and a short outdoor reset.

cards.title: Get your bearings on the campus map
cards.subtitle: Start before choosing a route
cards.notes: Open the interactive map, locate your residence hall and the Union, then save the walking route to your next stop before heading out.
cards.short_summary: Use the college’s map to orient yourself and find accessible routes or building locations.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo identifies its interactive campus map as the primary tool for finding building locations, parking, accessibility features, and directions.
cards.access_notes: Use the interactive map for current routes and construction or walkway updates.

cards.title: Make the Union your first indoor landmark
cards.subtitle: Campus hub · 1 College Circle
cards.notes: Walk through the Union, note the Concierge Desk, and check the posted event information so you know where to return during the weekend.
cards.short_summary: The Union brings together campus services, activities, student-life offices, and gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes MacVittie College Union as the heart of campus life and home to Starbucks, the ballroom, and student/residence-life offices.
cards.access_notes: The self-guided-tour page says visitors are welcome inside buildings that are open; regular Union hours are posted by Student Engagement.

cards.title: Find a calm base at Milne Library
cards.subtitle: 37 University Drive
cards.notes: Take a short loop through the renovated library and choose one collaboration or quiet-study area to revisit once classes begin.
cards.short_summary: Milne pairs study space with collaboration and innovation areas in a central campus building.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says Milne Library has collaboration and innovation spaces, natural light, and is a student gathering spot.
cards.access_notes: The self-guided-tour page says visitors may go inside buildings that are open.

cards.title: Plan a meal meet-up at Mary Jemison
cards.subtitle: 101 Letchworth Drive
cards.notes: Coordinate a meal with people from your floor, then use the walk back to compare which campus routes felt easiest to navigate.
cards.short_summary: Mary Jemison is one of Geneseo’s three main pay-one-price dining halls.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists Mary Jemison Dining Complex at 101 Letchworth Drive as one of its three main pay-one-price dining halls.
cards.access_notes: Meal access and payment depend on the dining plan or current dining arrangements.

cards.title: Join First Knight Celebration if it is on your schedule
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union Plaza and Patio
cards.notes: Use this orientation gathering to introduce yourself to someone new, sign the class banner if offered, and ask an orientation leader one practical question.
cards.short_summary: The fall-orientation schedule places a first-night gathering at the Union Plaza and Patio.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fall 2026 orientation schedule lists First Knight Celebration at MacVittie College Union Plaza and Patio, with mingling, a class banner, music, and novelties.
cards.source_title: Fall 2026 New Student Orientation Schedule - SUNY Geneseo
cards.access_notes: This is a scheduled orientation activity; confirm the current orientation schedule for timing and eligibility.

cards.title: Play a quick round at Corner Pocket
cards.subtitle: MacVittie College Union, Room 216
cards.notes: Bring a few new acquaintances for billiards, ping pong, or a board game; return equipment neatly so the next group can use it.
cards.short_summary: Corner Pocket is a free Union recreation room with games that make an easy group activity.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says Corner Pocket in College Union Room 216 has billiards, ping pong, and board games that are free to use.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Sunday–Thursday noon–11 p.m. and Friday–Saturday noon–10 p.m.; verify changes before going.

cards.title: Take a daylight reset in the Arboretum
cards.subtitle: South campus · 0.5-mile trail loop
cards.notes: Go in daylight, stay on the trail loop, and pause at the gazebo or native gardens before returning to campus with your group.
cards.short_summary: A short wooded loop, gardens, and a gazebo provide an on-campus outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo says the 20-acre Roemer Arboretum includes a 0.5-mile trail loop, native gardens, picnic tables, and a gazebo, and is open dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public from dawn to dusk; use the stated entrance and observe current parking rules.

cards.title: Browse the Student Organization Expo
cards.subtitle: Weeks of Welcome programming
cards.notes: Walk every row before committing; collect contact details for two groups that fit your interests and ask when newcomers can attend.
cards.short_summary: The Expo is a scheduled opportunity to learn about organizations during Weeks of Welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s Weeks of Welcome schedule lists a Student Organization Expo in the MacVittie College Union, and the program is intended to help students get involved with organizations.
cards.access_notes: The displayed schedule is actively updated; check the current Weeks of Welcome calendar for date, time, and location.

cards.title: Check the open-skate schedule
cards.subtitle: Myrtle A. Merritt Athletic Center
cards.notes: If an open-skate session is listed, bring your own skates, sign in at the arena entrance, and follow the no-sticks, no-pucks rule.
cards.short_summary: Recreational skating is offered at the campus ice rink when sessions are scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s Open Recreation page lists recreational skating at the ice rink and requires users to sign in; it says skaters need their own skates and no hockey equipment is allowed.
cards.access_notes: Schedules may change; check the Open Recreation page before going and follow arena sign-in requirements.

cards.title: Choose one current Weeks of Welcome event
cards.subtitle: Finish with the live campus calendar
cards.notes: Before the weekend ends, scan the live schedule and choose one upcoming event that matches your interests, then add it to your calendar.
cards.short_summary: Weeks of Welcome is the official early-semester program for connection, school spirit, and campus involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo describes Weeks of Welcome as the official start of a new semester, with events for student-organization involvement, athletic spirit, and campus connection.
cards.access_notes: Use the actively updated Weeks of Welcome schedule or College Events Calendar to confirm each event’s details.
